description:
A Stripe Checkout link that adds prepaid credit to this workspace: one-time by default, or AuditAE Monthly with monthly_plan: true. Nothing is charged by this call: give url to the user, who pays by card; the credit lands seconds after payment (get_balance confirms).

Billing: free — the user pays only if they complete the checkout. The link expires after 24 hours.

When to call: a paid tool returned out_of_credits, or the credit is short for the run the user asked for. Suggest an amount that covers the planned work and say what it's for.

Returns { url, amount_cents, amount_usd, expires_at, note }, or with monthly_plan { url, monthly_plan: true, price_cents, credit_cents_per_month, expires_at, note } ($299/month, $300 of credit a month, renews until cancelled; ask the user first). An agent workspace (no account behind it) also gets claim_url: the user opens it to sign up and take over the workspace.

amount_cents.description: Credit to add, in whole cents: 500–100000 ($5–$1000), e.g. 2500. Required unless monthly_plan is true.

monthly_plan.description: true: a link to start AuditAE Monthly instead of a one-time top-up. Needs an AuditAE account.

name: create_top_up_link
title: Create a Stripe checkout link to add AuditAE credit
